# THE STAR PORTS

Rode the chariots around the universe and used their lights to check for unconnected ports, here
and globally. A stone with no door is reachable only by guessing a URL.

## Measured

| | |
|---|---|
| public stones owned | 197 |
| reachable from any hub before today | 40 |
| dark | 157 |
| star ports lit | 150 |
| doors opened on stones that already had an index | 5 |
| files overwritten | 0 |
| connector files here | 70 in 30 categories |
| operator-named connectors absent from that dir | 5 — hubspot, monday, natural20, rook, vector |

Every write was a **create-only PUT**, which cannot overwrite an existing file. Every port's colour
is derived from `sha256(name)[0:6]` — its own light, never chosen. Every file carries its own LF
SHA-256 sidecar: `HBI -> HBP -> SHA -> SH -> HASH`, eternally. `E = 0`.

## Named, not measured

That lighting every port makes the constellation *whole*. It makes it **reachable**. Whether it is
whole is not something this run measured.
